title: Use a verified OpenVINO CPU runtime by default in Linux trip builds
source: rapidroom (original runtime validation/session integration; pinned Microsoft/Intel runtime binaries supplied locally)
notes: Linux x86_64 builds enable native-openvino by default and select a pre-staged, checksum-pinned CPU-only ORT 1.24.1/OpenVINO 2025.4.1 payload with full notices/relative aliases (126.935 MiB). Missing, invalid or unloadable payloads automatically retain bundled stock ORT CPU; core/API validation precedes irreversible ORT selection. Best/Fast/DeepSharpen explicitly register OpenVINO CPU, with model initialization fallback to CPU on the selected core. Actual provider, binary-bundle fingerprint and core build information enter cache identities. Original float16 weights/inputs and Sharpen remain unchanged. Unsupported platforms and no-default-feature builds retain the existing runtime. The trip build must stage/verify the local payload before packaging; no provider/model downloads, telemetry, GPU/NPU enablement, installation or official runtime distribution is added automatically.
